facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos after dropping out of Stanford University in her sophomore year.
Theranos has raised more than $400 million from equity sales and has been valued at over $9 billion.
The company operates a high-complexity laboratory certified by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.
Theranos tests can be performed using only a few drops of blood collected via a finger stick into a tiny vial called a nanotainer.
Theranos prices its tests to never exceed half the Medicare reimbursement rate for each procedure.
Walgreens has partnered with Theranos to establish collection centers in its drugstores.
